items.title: Can the U.S. and Iran take the off-ramp?
items.description: The U.S. military has paused its airstrikes on Iran after nearly two weeks of intensifying bombing, while diplomatic efforts have pushed forward to try to avert a return to all-out war.

items.title: Why Mali’s northern conflict has entered a dangerous new phase
items.description: A separatist–al-Qaeda alliance has shifted the balance of power in northern Mali and complicated efforts to end the war.

items.title: US pauses attacks on Iran for a second day and Tehran does, too
items.description: The pause comes amid efforts to resume negotiations on an interim ceasefire deal. The U.S. previously targeted Iranian coastal areas after Iran fired at ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine Both Report Civilians Killed in Strikes
items.description: Russia said four people were killed by a Ukrainian drone strike in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Horlivka.

items.title: Gaza: Dialysis patients face gruelling hospital journey by donkey cart
items.description: Shortly before sunrise, Palestinian Fathi Hajji begins an arduous thrice-weekly journey to Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis in the war-ravaged Gaza Strip.

items.title: Deadly attack on holiday camp in Russian-held part of Ukraine, officials say
items.description: At least 11 people were killed, including five children, in an overnight drone attack on a holiday camp in a Russian-held part of Ukraine's ‌Zaporizhzhia region, Russian installed local authorities said on Saturday, ⁠accusing Ukraine of deliberately attacking civilians.

items.title: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
items.description: The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.

items.description: A Polish-manufactured FlyEye reconnaissance drone was utilized by Ukraine’s 26th Separate Artillery Brigade to identify and destroy a Russian ammunition storage facility in the Bakhmut sector. items.title: Zelenskyy Says Russia Wants To Bring More North Korean Troops Into Ukraine War
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Moscow wants to bring in thousands of North Korean soldiers again for its invasion of Ukraine, with preparations in Russia having been under way since early summer.

items.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
items.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.
